name: אינטגרל מוכלל מ-(−∞) עד 0 – x·e^(nx) (באנגלית)
questiontext:
Evaluate the following improper integral if possible.
\[ \int^0_{-\infty} {{CT:0}} {{CT:1}} e^{{{CT:2}}{{CT:1}}} d{{CT:1}} \]
If the integral cannot be evaluated enter 99999 (5 9's). [[input:ans1]] [[validation:ans1]]
generalfeedback:
To solve this integral use the formula for integration by parts,\( \int u\frac{dv}{dx}dx= uv-\int v\frac{du}{dx}dx\)
Let\[u = {{CT:0}}{{CT:1}} , \frac{dv}{d{{CT:1}}} = e^{{{CT:2}}{{CT:1}}}\] Then \[\int{{CT:0}} {{CT:1}} e^{{{CT:2}}{{CT:1}}}d{{CT:1}} = \frac{{{CT:0}}{{CT:1}}e^{{{CT:2}}{{CT:1}}}}{{CT:2}}-\int \frac{{{CT:0}}e^{{{CT:2}}{{CT:1}}}}{{CT:2}} = {{CT:3}} \] Hence \[\int^0_{-\infty}{{CT:0}} {{CT:1}} e^{{{CT:2}}{{CT:1}}}d{{CT:1}} = \left[{{CT:3}}\right]^0_{-\infty} = {{CT:4}}\]

on_true.feedback: It looks like you may have differentiated instead!
